description: Bluebox notes at session start and a one-line nudge on prompts that match a moment.

hooks.command:
echo --% >/dev/null;: ' | Out-Null
<#'
[ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" ] || exit 0; exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/bluebox-hook.sh"
#>
if (-not $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) { exit 0 }; & ([scriptblock]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllText("$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/bluebox-hook.ps1")))

echo --% >/dev/null;: ' | Out-Null
<#'
[ -n "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}" ] || exit 0; exec sh "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/bluebox-hook.sh"
#>
if (-not $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT) { exit 0 }; & ([scriptblock]::Create([IO.File]::ReadAllText("$env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/bluebox-hook.ps1")))
